conditions.browser: Chrome extension; three simultaneous visible frames for full runs; canvas 1083x606 logical, 1624x909 physical at DPR 1.5. Normal speed, both built-in helpers and E key events; memory-only stores; no forced in-run rewards, time, weapons, counters or invulnerability.
conditions.foreground: User explicitly could not keep Chrome in the foreground. Occlusion/background scheduling affects frame intervals; no foreground FPS acceptance claim.
conditions.frameIntervalHistogram: 0.5ms bins saturate at >=200ms. A reported quantile of 200ms is a lower bound, not an exact value. CPU draw timings are measured separately.
conditions.sourceScope: All three complete runs used released 7ee8244 source before these presentation fixes. fusionRendererCases.method: Constructed stationary rendering fixture at 1100x650, area x2.4, real weapon fire/draw paths. Not a gameplay completion or a natural build. High/low quality; 80 warmed draw samples. CPU time only, no GPU/FPS claim. Same fixed post-construction geometry in paired versions.

pairedCpuFixture.method: Interleaved frozen real-renderer draw calls, same input, separate source canvases: 80 measured samples per source after eight warmups; source order alternates each iteration and yields every eight pairs. CPU only, not GPU/FPS. All scenes contain six fields, eight divine effects and two active skills. Lower density uses 70 projectiles/90 static drops; dense 480/180; loot-only 0/180. Separate contexts prevent one source from inheriting the other canvas command state.

limits: Not a manual no-helper clear or a beginner win-rate estimate.
Constructed density cases are not natural builds. Positions/counts/sizes are fixed; ordinary projectile visual phases retain the native initialization jitter.

Frozen draw CPU includes command submission and possible backend stalls; it does not measure GPU FPS. Independent source canvases and alternating order reduce cross-source command-state contamination.
At 480 projectiles, 180 drops, six fields, eight divine effects and two active skills, final CPU P95 still exceeds 33ms. No stable 30/60 FPS claim for this extreme input.
Initial shared-context probe and the first harness import error are retained in local outputs as preliminary evidence; accepted probes use separate canvases.
